# Renta Staffing Agency

> Renta Staffing Agency (trade name of MAXMEDIA LLC) finds household and office staff in Yerevan, Armenia. We have been working in Yerevan since 2017.

Old phone numbers and the old Wix site (rentaoutstaffing.wixsite.com) are no longer valid; use only the contacts below.

## Contacts

- Office: 4/12 Marshal Babajanyan Street, Yerevan, Armenia
- Phone: +374 41 303 395
- Email: office@renta.am
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 10:00-19:00
- Website (Russian): https://renta.am
- Website (English): https://renta.am/en/
- Contact page: https://renta.am/en/contact

## Services

### Children

- [Nanny for a child](https://renta.am/en/nanny): care, play and daily routine at home.
- [Nanny-housekeeper](https://renta.am/en/nanny-housekeeper): looks after the children and keeps the home in order.
- [Mother's help](https://renta.am/en/mothers-help): an extra pair of hands for a busy family.

### Home and housekeeping

- [Family housekeeper](https://renta.am/en/family-housekeeper): regular cleaning, laundry and home care.
- [Visiting housekeeper](https://renta.am/en/visiting-housekeeper): comes on set days instead of living in.
- [Housemaid](https://renta.am/en/housemaid): detailed cleaning and care of rooms and linen.
- [House manager (housekeeper)](https://renta.am/en/house-manager): runs the household, staff and supplies.

### Care and health

- [Carer for an older person at home](https://renta.am/en/older-people-care)
- [Companion carer for retired people](https://renta.am/en/companion-carer)
- [Nursing carer for a bedridden patient](https://renta.am/en/nursing-carer)

### Kitchen and events

- [Private chef](https://renta.am/en/private-chef): daily meals for a family at home.
- [Waiting staff for private and corporate events](https://renta.am/en/event-waiting-staff)

### Private household and VIP

- [Private household staff](https://renta.am/en/private-household-staff): housekeeper, butler, cook and maid for a private home.
- [Family assistant](https://renta.am/en/family-assistant): errands, schedules and household organisation.
- [Wardrobe management](https://renta.am/en/wardrobe-management): care of a VIP wardrobe.

### Drivers

- [Family driver](https://renta.am/en/family-driver)
- [Executive chauffeur](https://renta.am/en/executive-chauffeur)

### Office and business

- [Executive assistant](https://renta.am/en/executive-assistant)
- [Office cleaning](https://renta.am/en/office-cleaning): keeping offices and meeting rooms clean.
- [Guest relations](https://renta.am/en/guest-relations): reception and welcoming of visitors.
- [Promotional (BTL) staff for exhibitions and campaigns](https://renta.am/en/promotional-staff)

### For specific households

- [Domestic staff for expats and foreign families living in Yerevan](https://renta.am/en/domestic-staff-for-expats)
- [Villa staff](https://renta.am/en/villa-staff)
